POST /v1/image-to-video200 OK
Request
# Turn a photo into a 5-second video
curl https://api.spicylab.ai/v1/image-to-video \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SPICYLAB_API_KEY" \
  -d '{
    "image_url": "https://cdn.example.com/photo.jpg",
    "duration": 5,
    "resolution": "480p"
  }'
# Turn a photo into a 5-second video
import requests

res = requests.post(
    "https://api.spicylab.ai/v1/image-to-video",
    headers={"Authorization": "Bearer " + API_KEY},
    json={"image_url": "https://cdn.example.com/photo.jpg",
          "duration": 5, "resolution": "480p"})
// Turn a photo into a 5-second video
const res = await fetch(
  "https://api.spicylab.ai/v1/image-to-video", {
  method: "POST",
  headers: { Authorization: "Bearer " + API_KEY },
  body: JSON.stringify({
    image_url: "https://cdn.example.com/photo.jpg",
    duration: 5, resolution: "480p" })
});
